definitions.name: Wanderer
definitions.description: A flexible adventurer shaped by travel, improvisation, and broad experience.

initialRoutes.explanation: Your uncommitted training leaves room for a broad adventuring path.

specializations.name: Bard
specializations.description: An adaptable traveler who gathers and performs the stories of many communities.

routes.explanation: Repeated successful performances turn your traveled stories into a practiced identity.

definitions.name: Warrior
definitions.description: A martial path built around direct weapon use, strength, and durable defense.

initialRoutes.explanation: Your sword and close-combat equipment reveal a martial foundation.
Your strength and heavy protection support a direct martial path.

specializations.name: Swordsman
specializations.description: A focused practitioner of sword guards, cuts, counters, and controlled footwork.

routes.explanation: Continued sword use supports a dedicated sword specialization.

specializations.name: Shieldbearer
specializations.description: A protector trained to hold space, intercept attacks, and maintain a defensive line.

routes.explanation: Repeatedly preventing harm to allies reveals a protective specialization.

specializations.name: Berserker
specializations.description: A controlled aggression specialist who remains dangerous while injured.

routes.explanation: Continuing to fight effectively while injured reveals a berserker specialization.

specializations.name: Squire
specializations.description: A disciplined martial attendant trained in arms, armor, protection, and service.

routes.explanation: Formal service and martial instruction reveal the Squire specialization.

definitions.name: Archer
definitions.description: A ranged martial path focused on bows, positioning, and precise attacks.

initialRoutes.explanation: Carrying and preparing a bow reveals a ranged martial path.

definitions.name: Rogue
definitions.description: An agile path of opportunistic attacks, precision, and practical cunning.

initialRoutes.explanation: Your dagger equipment supports a fast, precision-based path.
Your paired daggers strongly favor an agile close-combat style.

specializations.name: Thief
specializations.description: A specialist in protected-property infiltration, locks, traps, and indirect acquisition.

routes.explanation: Repeatedly bypassing locks reveals a Thief specialization.
Repeatedly identifying or bypassing traps reveals a Thief specialization.

definitions.name: Priest
definitions.description: A faith-driven support and combat path using blessings, wards, and sacred power.

initialRoutes.explanation: Your blessed focus provides the foundation for a sacred combat role.

definitions.name: Mage Apprentice
definitions.description: A foundational magical path centered on spellcraft, mana, and arcane control.

initialRoutes.explanation: Your staff provides a practical focus for foundational magic.
Your prepared spell demonstrates the beginnings of formal spellcraft.

specializations.name: Necromancer
specializations.description: A practitioner focused on remains, spirits, vitality, and controlled Death magic.

routes.explanation: Repeated controlled Death magic reveals a necromantic specialization.
Developed Death affinity and practical spell use reveal a necromantic specialization.

specializations.name: Elementalist
specializations.description: A caster who studies multiple elemental sources and their practical interactions.

routes.explanation: Stable practice with multiple elemental sources reveals an Elementalist specialization.

definitions.name: Healer
definitions.description: A practical restoration path focused on stabilization, cleansing, recovery, and keeping a party alive under pressure.

initialRoutes.explanation: Repeated treatment under pressure reveals a practical restoration path.
Demonstrated healing supported by Life affinity reveals a restorative path.
Formal instruction gives you the foundation to serve as a party healer.

definitions.name: Alchemist
definitions.description: A combat-reaction path using bombs, catalysts, toxins, mutagens, transmutation, and prepared battlefield formulas.

initialRoutes.explanation: Repeated use of prepared reactions in danger reveals a combat-alchemy path.
Developing a repeatable reagent reaction reveals an alchemical foundation.
Formal alchemical instruction gives you a foundation for dangerous field formulas.

definitions.name: Mage
definitions.description: A fully independent structured caster capable of stabilizing and constructing complete spell formulas.

definitions.name: Spellsword
definitions.description: An integrated martial caster who sustains spell structures in melee and channels magic through a weapon.

initialRoutes.explanation: Your practical ore extraction revealed the Miner profession.

specializations.name: Prospector
specializations.description: A mining specialist trained to locate and evaluate valuable deposits.

routes.explanation: Sustained extraction practice reveals a talent for prospecting deposits.

advancementRecipes.name: Mage
advancementRecipes.description: Advance beyond apprenticeship into independent structured spellcraft.

routes.explanation: Your independent spell construction demonstrates mastery beyond apprenticeship.

advancementRecipes.name: Spellsword
advancementRecipes.description: Converge mastered martial and structured magical paths into a single integrated combat identity.

routes.explanation: You have practiced sustaining spell structures during direct weapon combat.
